notes.title: Update 1.10 is Out!
notes.content:
[h3]Good Sol to You, Strategists![/h3]

This update includes several improvements designed to enhance your gameplay experience:
[list]
[*] [b]Animated Intro[/b]: Immerse yourself with the new animated introduction.
[*] [b]Wave Variability[/b]: Encounter more diverse and challenging waves of enemies, keeping every battle fresh.
[*] [b]Rebalanced Enemies[/b]: Enjoy a more balanced combat experience with reworked enemy stats and behaviours.
[*] [b]Various Fixes[/b]: Bug-fixes and minor improvements.
[/list]
I also wish to inform you that the Journal feature has been postponed to Update 1.20. I apologise for the delay and appreciate your understanding as I continue to refine this key aspect of the game.

[h3]These updates improve the overall gameplay experience. Thank you for your continued support and feedback![/h3]

notes.title: [Update 1.00.8] Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]New Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Bugfix: [/b]Resolved the 'Master Strategist' achievement issue.
[*] [b]Bugfix: [/b]Fixed the blinking tooltip in certain situations.
[*] [b]Progress Reset: [/b]Nullified values in stats after resetting progress.
[*] [b]Game Logic: [/b]Enhanced game sequencing logic for smoother gameplay.
[*] [b]Settings: [/b]Fixed jitteriness in the settings scroll.
[/list]

[h3]These updates enhance stability and improve the overall gameplay experience. Thank you for your continued support and feedback![/h3]

tags.bug: [b]Bugfix: [/b]Fixed the blinking tooltip in certain situations.

notes.title: So, What's Next? UPCOMING UPDATES!
notes.content:
Get ready for a series of awesome updates! From crucial bug fixes in v1.00.8 to new achievements, enemy behaviours, and a free DLC in v1.10, there's a lot to look forward to. Plus, v1.20 introduces the innovative 'SIMULATION' mode and global leaderboards. [u]Stay tuned for these exciting enhancements and more![/u]

[b]Current Version: 1.00 (as of May 31st)[/b]
[i]Technically: 1.00.1, where 'x' represents bugfixes and minor improvements.[/i]

[h2]Upcoming Updates[/h2]

[h3]UPDATE v1.00.8:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bugfix: 'Master Strategist' achievement.
[*] Bugfix: Tooltip blinks in certain situations.
[*] Improvement to game sequencing logic.
[/list]
[i][b]Release Date: [u]Coming days[/u][/b][/i]

[h3]UPDATE v1.10:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Additional achievements.
[*] Enhanced high-tier enemy behaviour.
[*] Increased wave variability (medium, hard, and nightmare rework).
[*] New 'Journal' feature: Delve into The Echoes of Mars lore.
[*] Free DLC: Supporter's Pack, including game development materials—sketches, early artwork, development process videos, and a short film about the developer.
[/list]
[i][b]Release Date: [u]June 28th, 2024[/u][/b][/i]

[h3]UPDATE v1.20:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New 'SIMULATION' mode: Plan the perfect tactics for various waves without restrictions. Customize enemy waves, energy amounts, tower costs, and more!
[*] Ability to import/export setups for others to play with your configurations. (Steam Workshop compatibility pending.)
[*] New 'LEADERBOARD' section to compete globally and with friends.
[*] Enhanced game statistics.
[*] Additional achievements.
[/list]
[i][b]Release Date: [u]July 28th, 2024[/u][/b][/i]

Until next time!

[i]Best regards,
Georgii Antipin
Your Indie Developer[/i]
